name: How is drywall repaired after removing an old kitchen backsplash?

mainEntity.name: How is drywall repaired after removing an old kitchen backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall behind tile backsplashes often tears down to the brown paper core when old tiles are removed, making it unsuitable for direct retiling. If only surface paper tore over a small area, scraping loose paper, coating it with an oil-based primer, and skimming it flat may suffice. However, if the gypsum core is broken, gouged deeply, or water-damaged around the sink, cutting out that section and installing fresh drywall or cement backer board is safer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Torn drywall must be sealed with primer and skimmed flat, or completely cut out and replaced if the gypsum core is damaged from tile removal.
